stem.text: In which example is it **not** possible for the underlined body to be in equilibrium?

A.text: An <u>aeroplane</u> climbs at a steady rate.

B.text: An aeroplane tows a <u>glider</u> at a constant altitude.

C.text: A <u>speedboat</u> changes direction at a constant speed.

D.text: Two boats tow a <u>ship</u> into harbour.
